scope: Research experiment only: inventory executable IQ formats, test llama.cpp's OpenVINO NPU backend, and build a real iMatrix-calibrated routed-expert mix with a Strata pack. No default setup choice or runtime backend was changed.

iq_inventory.imatrix_optional_but_consumed: The pinned ggml_quantize_chunk passes the same importance pointer to every listed quantizer, including IQ2_S and the K-quants.
iq_inventory.calibration distinction: llama.cpp iMatrix is summed squared activation importance, not GPTQ's Hessian/OBQ solve. GSQ explicitly uses GPTQ initialization followed by Gumbel-Softmax refinement, but its current wrappers do not cover Qwen3.8 Flash Next's hybrid qwen4exp structure.

quantized_artifact.reported_quant_size: 63551.82 MiB at 3.01 BPW over the model's 93851.82 MiB / 4.45 BPW source
recipe: All non-target tensors retain their exact source GGUF type.
ffn_gate_exps and ffn_up_exps use IQ2_XS with the provided per-expert iMatrix.
ffn_down_exps uses Q2_0 because the 640-value inner dimension is not a whole 256-value block for IQ2_S.
The intermediate GGUF's routers remain F32 because llama.cpp hard-skips ffn_gate_inp before manual tensor overrides.

llama_npu_backend.strata_current_engine: No NPU backend: the built engine links CUDA/cuBLAS and its custom CPU pool; ldd has no OpenVINO backend.
llama_npu_backend.llama_cpp_pinned_source: Contains ggml/src/ggml-openvino and translates GGML MUL_MAT_ID, including quantized MoE expert tensors, through OpenVINO.
llama_npu_backend.device_enumeration: GGML_OPENVINO_DEVICE=NPU reports OpenVINO: using device NPU and exposes OPENVINO0.

target_model_attempt.conclusion: The pinned llama.cpp OpenVINO backend can target NPU, but this real qwen4exp quantized graph falls back on every routed expert matmul and then hits an NPU layout mismatch. It is not a usable Strata replacement path as-is.

side_effects: Downloaded and retained the pinned source model and iMatrix in the main-machine cache.
Created a 66.65 GB experimental intermediate GGUF and 1.4 GiB Strata pack in ignored cache paths; neither is committed.
Created private RESMP-DEV mirrors of GSQ and RCO with GitHub Actions disabled.
Built ignored llama.cpp CPU tools on the main machine and OpenVINO tools on strix.
Transferred the pack to strix; the intermediate GGUF transfer completed and its hash was verified on strix.
non_claims: No perplexity, benchmark score, output-quality comparison, or same-day throughput comparison has run for the new expert mix.
The intermediate GGUF retains F32 routers. BF16 routers exist in the Strata pack, where all 96 router tensor conversions are exact.
The 98.4 GB IQ4_XS source is already quantized; this is a real requantization experiment, not a quality-equivalent BF16-source calibration.
The public iMatrix has 246 of 73728 expert-row count slots with zero observations; llama.cpp substitutes those paths rather than failing.
GSQ/RCO were mirrored and inspected, but their GPTQ-style pipeline was not run on Qwen3.8 because the required qwen4exp wrapper is absent.
The tiny llama NPU result does not establish Strata NPU performance or compatibility with Qwen3.8.
The main-machine and Strix quantizations are not byte-identical; the whole-file hash difference and one-token output difference do not quantify quality.
